title: Cancel Your $200/mo AI Bill: Running DeepSeek R1 Locally with Ollama

scenes.title: The $200 Bill Cancelled
scenes.headline: Cancel Your $200/mo AI Bill
scenes.visual_directive: OpenAI billing invoice card ($200.00/mo) stamped with giant glowing crimson 'CANCELLED' rubber stamp; glowing sub-pill 'Run 100% offline on your laptop for $0'
scenes.spoken_script: OpenAI wants two hundred dollars a month for reasoning models. But what if you could run a frontier reasoning model on your laptop for zero dollars, completely offline, on airplane mode, right now?

scenes.title: The DeepSeek R1 Shift
scenes.headline: How DeepSeek R1 Learned to Think
scenes.visual_directive: Comparison between old human-labeled fine-tuning (red X) and DeepSeek R1 pure reinforcement learning self-exploration (cyan lightning)
scenes.spoken_script: Enter DeepSeek R1. Unlike traditional models trained by human labelers, R1 trained itself through pure reinforcement learning. It discovered how to think, backtrack, and self-correct entirely on its own.

scenes.title: The Terminal Think Block
scenes.headline: Inside the <think> Tag
scenes.visual_directive: macOS dark terminal running 'ollama run deepseek-r1:8b'; animated <think> tag opening with live self-debating logic and verification checks
scenes.spoken_script: Run 'ollama run deepseek-r1' in your terminal. Watch what happens: before answering, it opens a think block. It actively debates edge cases, catches its own logic traps, and rewrites its proof before giving you the final answer.

scenes.title: Hardware Reality Check
scenes.headline: Which Model Fits Your Machine?
scenes.visual_directive: 3-tier hardware matrix: 1.5B (80 tok/s, any laptop), 8B (35 tok/s, sweet spot for devs), 70B (4 tok/s, Boeing 747 alert)
scenes.spoken_script: Now for the reality check. The one-point-five billion model runs on a toaster at eighty tokens a second. The eight-billion model is the sweet spot for coding. But try running the full seventy-billion model on a base MacBook, and your laptop will sound like a Boeing 747.

scenes.title: Setup & Blog Outro
scenes.headline: Set It Up in 3 Minutes
scenes.visual_directive: Quickstart curl command; IDE integration badges (VS Code, Cursor, Continue.dev); glowing CTA card to govindtank.is-a.dev/blog
scenes.spoken_script: You can hook it into VS Code, Cursor, or your terminal in three minutes with zero API keys. I wrote the complete step-by-step setup guide and benchmarks on my blog at govindtank.is-a.dev. Go check it out.
